s0404.idiomatic: On jisi day the Hutuo River dikes were repaired.

s0407.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Palm-fiber Hall was constructed.

s0408.literal: On bingzi day the Zhexi Branch Censorate said, "Envoys who perform proxy sacrifices throughout the realm abandon public duty for private gain and are often not sincere and pure; because of this the spirits are not pleased — we request careful selection.

s0410.idiomatic: On wuyin day princes Qututaimishi and others came to court; gold, silver, ingots of notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

s0411.idiomatic: On jimao day the 4 circuits of Hejian, Zhending, Baoding, and Ruizhou suffered famine; wine brewing was forbidden.

s0412.idiomatic: Tibetan bandits in Jie Prefecture raided; the Gongchang commander-in-chief's headquarters dispatched troops to repel them.

s0414.idiomatic: Baoding Route suffered famine; 40,000 ingots of notes and 15,000 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0416.idiomatic: Nanbin Prefecture, Di Prefecture, and other places had flooding and the people suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain were granted in relief, and ingots of notes were given to bury the dead.

s0417.idiomatic: The 3 relay stations of Wuhuacheng, Sumietu, Zhuozhigan, and Mawu suffered famine; 2,000 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0419.idiomatic: Shandong surveillance commissioner Xu Shijing requested promulgation of clan burial regulations and prohibition of yin-yang geomantic superstitions.

s0420.idiomatic: Second month, on jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the Altar of the Spirits of Agriculture.

s0421.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Dao Classic was promulgated to famous mountains, monasteries, and temples throughout the realm.

s0422.literal: On dinghai day Deniang, chieftain of the Pingfa Miao, leading his one hundred thousand households, came to submit; three hundred sixty native officials requested audience at court.
s0422.idiomatic: On dinghai day Deniang, chieftain of the Pingfa Miao, leading his 100,000 households, came to submit; 360 native officials requested audience at court.

s0423.idiomatic: The Huguang Branch Secretariat requested reduction of the multitude and return to their districts; Deniang and 46 others were ordered to come to audience — approved.

s0424.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhang Sicheng, thirty-ninth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was elevated to Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way.

s0425.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn gathered at Bi.

s0426.idiomatic: On xinmao day 3 months' grain was granted in relief to the troops of Prince Ding'an Duo'erzhiban.

s0427.literal: Java sent its minister Xila Sengajiliye presenting a memorial and local products in tribute.
s0427.idiomatic: Java sent its minister Xila Sengajiliye presenting a memorial and local products in tribute.

s0429.idiomatic: On dingyou day a comet was observed at the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy.

s0430.idiomatic: On jihai day Western monks were ordered to perform altar-burning Buddhist rites at Yanhua Pavilion.

s0433.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tuhulu was additionally appointed grand preceptor, remaining censor-in-chief.

s0451.idiomatic: On guisi day 10,000 brood mares were purchased from the market.
